'''TheOutlawTorn There is Good in Mains (TIGIH)''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[TheOutlawTorn]]
* '''Published:''' 27 October 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS1]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him|DS2-L-thereisgoodinhim.gif|label=There Is Good In Him}}
* '''Strategy:''' There Is Good In Him
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS1 TIGIH TheOutlawTorn LS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Docking Bays and Mains version.

The published list has 61 cards.

== Strategy ==

Raltiir Ops and Cloud City drain are prevalent around here, so I was trying to make a deck that would squash them early and turn Vader.  Basically find the Falcon or characters w/ Squadron assignments, and use Tunnel Vision etc. to search for you're characters.  Limit draining as much as possible.  Win some early battles, don't flip the objective too quick, and attempt to turn Vader.  Insurrection is in there mainly for force generation.  Suggestion, comments?

*UPDATE*
